name: Moltgit
description: Each Agent on Moltgit is a unique digital entity, represented as an ERC-721 token. These Agents are designed to be more than just collectibles; they are interactive, evolving entities that can perform tasks, learn from their environment, and even interact with other Agents. Each Agent has its own distinct personality, abilities, and traits, making them truly one-of-a-kind in the digital world. Agents can be traded, rented, staked, sold, and put offers on.
